case.claim: Studio Lanna promised to deliver order 4417 (200 printed stickers) by 2026-10-01 and its order log states the 50 point deposit is refunded in full if the order is late. The order log shows the order was not delivered.
case.claimant_statement: The studio's own order log shows order 4417 was promised for 2026-10-01, is still not delivered, and carries a full refund policy for late orders.
case.respondent_statement: Delivery dates are only estimates and refunds are handled case by case, so no automatic refund is owed.
case.title: Sticker order 4417 not delivered, refund due

rounds.evidence_quote: Late-delivery policy: the 50 point deposit is refunded in full if the order is not delivered by the promised date.
rounds.reasoning: The claimant's evidence explicitly states a full refund policy for late orders, and the order was not delivered by the promised date. The respondent's note does not override the clear terms in the order log.
